_comment: The groups this system runs. Each has its own Google Sheet, its own
Telegram group, and its own prices. Nothing is shared between them except
the payments bot and the posting bot.
Secrets are NOT here. For a group with envPrefix APPSC_NEWS_EN, .env must
carry SHEET_URL_APPSC_NEWS_EN, SHEET_TOKEN_APPSC_NEWS_EN and
TELEGRAM_GROUP_APPSC_NEWS_EN. Keeping the shape here and the secrets there
means this file can be read, reviewed and committed safely.
planShapes below defines what a pass IS. Each group then sets what it
COSTS, so a price can differ per group without five copies of the wording.
paymentBotEnv says which payment bot sells this group. Groups sharing a value
share a bot, so a student buying either newspaper group talks to one bot.
subjects is the tab list for that group's sheet. The Apps Script reads it from
a SUBJECTS_JSON script property, so the same google_apps_script.js is pasted
into every sheet and each one declares its own subjects rather than five
copies of the file drifting apart.

shortName is what the dashboard switcher shows. The full label and language are too long for the header, and a truncated group name is worse than a short one: it is the field that says which sheet you are about to write to.

ONE PASS: each group sells a single pass at Rs 199 (19900 paise). sprint_30 and autopay_monthly are "retired": no longer offered anywhere, but still defined so a member who bought one keeps working — their renewal webhook, reminders and /cancel all still look the plan up by id. Do not delete them while anyone holds one. Their prices here are only what the dashboard shows for them; a member's own record keeps what they actually paid. The pass name, price and valid-until date can be overridden per bot from the dashboard (Pass & Coupons page) without editing this file.

passPlanId says which pass a group sells. It defaults to exam_pass; the two newspaper groups sell lifetime_pass and EPFO sells epfo_pass instead. Plans a group no longer sells stay listed so members who already bought them keep resolving.

fixedEndDateEnv names the env var holding a dated pass's last day (dd-mm-yyyy); fixedEndDate is the fallback when that var is unset. epfo_pass has its own (24-12-2026: the exam is on 20-12-2026 and access runs four days past it), because the EPFO exam is not on the APPSC exam's date. The date set on the dashboard's Pass & Coupons page wins over both.

subjectCodes (optional, per group) fixes the three-letter prefix of each subject's Question IDs. Without it the prefix is the subject's first three letters, which gives Indian Culture and Industrial Relations the same one.

affiliate says whether influencers can apply to promote a group. Only the APPSC Newspaper groups are open for now; the influencer bot shows one entry per payment bot, so both newspaper groups appear as one exam.

sprint_30.label: 30-Day Sprint Pass
sprint_30.description: Full access to every subject topic for 30 days.

autopay_monthly.label: Monthly Auto-Pay
autopay_monthly.description: Renews itself every 30 days over UPI AutoPay or card. Cancel whenever you like.

exam_pass.label: Target 2026 Pass
exam_pass.tagline: Valid until exam day — best value
exam_pass.description: One payment, access right through to the exam. No renewals to remember.

lifetime_pass.label: Lifetime Pass
lifetime_pass.tagline: Pay once, keep access for life
lifetime_pass.description: One payment, access for life. No renewals, no expiry date, nothing to remember.

epfo_pass.label: Target EPFO Pass
epfo_pass.description: One payment, access right through the EPFO exam on 20-12-2026 and until 24-12-2026. No renewals to remember.
